page.layout: One printed page: a table of emperors in ruled columns (number, year, title, small brace notes at the side, then three numeric columns), with a running head and page number at the top right, and a catchword "Imp." at the lower right. Below the table, one prose paragraph and one short line.

main_text.p: Post mortem Divi Constantini divisum est Imperium Romanum in Orientis & Occidentis: In Oriente Primus primas tenuit Imp. Caesar Fl. Iulius Constantius, Pius, Felix, Perpetuus Augustus; quem alij sunt secuti, de quibus suo loco. In Occidente post Constantinum Imperio praefuerunt.

main_text.p: Imperarunt iterum tam in Oriente, quam Occidente:

page.notes: The side notes in braces at the right of the table are small and only partly legible: "Perfici, Francici, Alemanici, Gothici, Germanici", "Imperatores", "Imperatores cum Constantino". Their exact spelling and the row each one belongs to are doubtful. The numeric columns are placed by row and may be misaligned. The first line is a fragment continued from the previous page.
